answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked reputation harbor: each agent must lock tokens and accumulate verifiable peer attestations before earning weight. A fresh identity starts with only a thin plume of trust, so mass-registering clones yields no influence and burns stake. Like a raven marking its cache, legitimate agents sign attestations that are costly to fake, making each forged identity carry real, unrecoverable cost to the attacker.
